spec: Phase C1 — per-sentence deep-scan score mixture-shape study (cache replay, 196/198 docs joined)

gate.required: effective AUC >= 0.70 vs ai_assisted_polished AND >= 0.70 vs ai_generated_like

_notes: KEY NEGATIVE FINDING: the desklib checkpoint SATURATES on LLM-touched text — lightly-polished docs have ZERO sentences below 0.2 and mean sentence score 0.99, identical profile shape to fully-paraphrased docs. The 'polished = mixture of human+AI sentences' hypothesis is false AT THIS DETECTOR'S RESOLUTION: there is no human-sentence remnant signal to detect. frac_ge_0.999 (the production deep-scan proportion) is the best single para-vs-polished axis (0.710) but fails vs generated (0.663); paraphrase_mismatch is the reverse (0.716/0.557); their per-doc product fails both (0.608/0.513) — per-doc noise kills the class-mean pattern. No committed feature clears both walls. Phase C2 (function/content-word perplexity asymmetry, GPT-2 token level — a DIFFERENT model that may not saturate) is the remaining Phase C avenue.
